recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. The core model now reflects FHIR-25057 plus the later FHIR-26570 CodeableReference decision; further product-reference cardinality or datatype changes should be handled by a new BRR decision.
issue_request: FHIR-25057 was a Published/Persuasive BRR R5 change request asking to make MedicinalProductDefinition.crossReference a BackboneElement so it could carry the referenced product and a separate crossReference.type relationship code.
initial_application: The structural request appears to have been applied by d017cd22c28c50b2e285e0a2b5dc87edcc6dbb71, whose message says it made MedicinalProductDefinition Product Cross-Reference a backbone element and added a type, despite using the apparent typo GF#25067. The commit changed the old repeated Identifier crossReference into a parent with product[x] and type children; later XML source migration retained that shape.
additional_context: FHIR-26570 later changed crossReference.product to CodeableReference(MedicinalProductDefinition), and that later issue is already represented on the combined branch by f9d6a727e79e31c052fb4a01fb19d9080e258358. Current fhir.ini keeps MedicinalProductDefinition active. The current StructureDefinition already has crossReference as BackboneElement, product as CodeableReference, and type as CodeableConcept, but the type binding description was stale and contradicted the ProductCrossReferenceType value set and code system descriptions.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicinalproductdefinition/structuredefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition.xml so MedicinalProductDefinition.crossReference.type binding description reads "Relationship to another Medicinal Product." No other crossReference structure change was needed.
source_changes: source/medicinalproductdefinition/structuredefinition-MedicinalProductDefinition.xml: corrected the ProductCrossReferenceType binding description for MedicinalProductDefinition.crossReference.type.

related_jiras.note: Published later BRR issue that simplified crossReference.product to CodeableReference(MedicinalProductDefinition); already audited on the combined branch.
